CustomField.description: BR-15, BR-16, PD-12. THE SELLER INPUT, not evidence. A seller ticks this to explicitly accept responsibility for a Marketing-qualified Lead. It is the one field in the acceptance model a human writes, and it is deliberately separate from the three evidence fields the automation writes - so an acceptance can be asserted but never back-dated, re-attributed or silently rewritten. Ticking it does not by itself move the lifecycle: SAL still requires the governed transition. Equally, moving to SAL without ticking it is refused, which is what keeps acceptance from being inferred from Status.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Tick to explicitly accept responsibility for this Marketing-qualified Lead.
CustomField.label: Sales Accepted
